description: Get database status and configuration for a project. Returns provider (Neon/Turso/Cloud SQL), tier, connection status, enabled extensions, and pricing info. Use to diagnose "can't connect to database" issues — check if a database was provisioned, its status, and whether it's reachable. Does NOT return connection string values (security) — use list_env_vars to check if DATABASE_URL is set.
name: get_database_info
